spreadsheet_summary: Compact renewal tracker for Q3 planning — primary use for weekly CS huddles. Rows include contract end, ARR, and a qualitative risk note. Weighted ARR is calculated externally as ARR * (Renewal Prob). Use 'Escalation Level' to route accounts: Level 0 = green/transactional, Level 1 = monitor, Level 2 = requires manager involvement, Level 3 = executive intervention. The sheet is intentionally concise to fit into a one-slide QBR segment.
methodology: Probability assignments are a CS team heuristic combining product usage trend, executive engagement, procurement readiness, and support ticket volume. For forecast blending, finance uses a 30/70 conservative blend: 30% of high-confidence renewals (>=80%) plus 70% of full-weighted total. Update 'Last Contact' when any customer-facing touchpoint happens.
